tools.name: electrical-engineering_load-schedule-calculate
tools.description: Calculate kW, kVA, and current for caller-supplied loads using supplied voltage and power factor. Missing values are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/load-schedule-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_three-phase-load-balance-check
tools.description: Compare phase-leg currents from supplied loads and report imbalance percentage. Optional caller rule thresholds are compared when provided. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/three-phase-load-balance-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_voltage-drop-calculate
tools.description: Calculate voltage drop from supplied cable resistance/reactance, length, and load current. Cable tables are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/voltage-drop-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_cable-sizing-calculate
tools.description: Compare calculated design current to caller-supplied cable ampacity. Ampacity tables are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/cable-sizing-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_breaker-rating-check
tools.description: Compare calculated design current to caller-supplied breaker ratings and continuous factors. Code rules are not invented. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/breaker-rating-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_transformer-capacity-calculate
tools.description: Compare transformer rated kVA to supplied or schedule load kVA and report loading percentage. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/transformer-capacity-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_power-factor-correction-calculate
tools.description: Calculate required kVAR (and optional capacitance) to move from a supplied power factor to a supplied target. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/power-factor-correction-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_generator-sizing-calculate
tools.description: Size required generator kVA from supplied load and caller diversity, reserve, and derate factors. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/generator-sizing-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_ev-charger-load-capacity-check
tools.description: Check EV charger design current against caller-supplied panel capacity and existing load. Continuous factors are used only when supplied. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/ev-charger-load-capacity-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: electrical-engineering_design-document-audit
tools.description: Audit completeness of supplied electrical design inputs and aggregate load, balance, drop, cable, breaker, transformer, PF, generator, and EV checks. Does not invent code compliance. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/electrical-engineering/design-document-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
